column1: # Canonical privacy scale. L0 least private, L3 most private. Fail-closed default L3.
# outbound: may the level's content leave the owner's local chat (cloud model, channel, other people, export, owner's WhatsApp/iMessage)?
# Per-writer default level, stamped on write when the record carries no level of its own.
# Builders READ this table (src/source_defaults.py); no code constant may repeat it.
#   - a default never overrides a STRICTER level the writer already computed (rank only moves up);
#   - the Art.9/10 + finance + credentials + government-ID floor always applies on top (raise only);
#   - L0 and L1 are NEVER a default;
#   - an unknown or unlisted writer is L3.
# First row: Andy's 2026-11-16 relabel decision ("never less private"; unknown writer = L3).
# ai_conversations is L3: the locked CLAUDE.md rule "AI conversations default to privacy_level: L3" (Archie ruling 2026-11-17). A default may never be below a locked default.
